verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner: the wordmark, headline, body and badges share one left edge, and the CTA stands alone on the right. Its flaws are an orphaned 'and bottles.' line, an oversized dead gap between the headline and the body, and a circle that almost touches the top and bottom edges. B's GLACIER wordmark floats centred and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge. Its body copy and CTA are jammed against the bottom edge, and the circle crowds the canvas edges. The right-hand badge and CTA cluster also feels disconnected from the copy.
